caption: The drawing depicts a decorative architectural column and arch. The column base is rectangular with orange-brown panels bordered in white and blue wavy lines, and it rests on a gray base set on red-orange tiles. A blue and green diamond-checkered band wraps around the top portion of the column. Midway up the column, a gray shell-shaped ornament is attached. Above, the column capital is adorned with swirling blue patterns and golden-yellow foliate detailing beneath a yellow horizontal molding. Rising out of the capital is an arch, colored tan with a crackled texture and bordered by thin orange and green lines. Behind the arch, a vertical decorative panel contains green, blue, and orange wavy patterns and a small design of flower-like shapes. The drawing is signed "Howard H. Sherman" at the bottom right, and the lower left includes the annotation "Scale 1 1/2" = 1'". The composition features muted pastel background colors with the architectural details in brighter, more saturated hues.
title: Pilaster with Holy Water-Font & Arch Below Choir Loft
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
